posts.body:
​
NPC Dialogue Speech Bubble​
Version:
v3.1
Author:
ToshAngel
Overview​
NPC Dialogue Speech Bubble is a powerful plugin for RPG Maker MZ that enables developers to display customizable speech bubbles above NPCs (Non-Player Characters) on the game map. With extensive customization options for appearance and behavior, you can create a more immersive and interactive dialogue system in your game.
Key Features​
Customizable Appearance:​
Text:
Define message content with support for line breaks.
Text Color:
Choose text colors using HEX codes.
Font Size:
Adjust the size of the message text.
Background Image:
Utilize custom images for the speech bubble background.
Arrow Image:
Customize the tail of the speech bubble with specific images.
Opacity Settings:
Control the transparency of both the message window and the arrow.
Message Behavior:​
Display Duration:
Specify how long a message is visible (in frames; 60 frames = 1 second).
Activation Distance:
Set the distance in tiles at which the message activates.
Repeat Modes:
never:
Show the message only once.
onMapReload:
Repeat the message each time the player re-enters the map.
onApproach:
Display the message every time the player enters the activation zone.
Advanced Functionality:​
Random Messages:
Display one random message from a predefined list.
Delays Between Messages:
Insert pauses between consecutive messages.
Variable and Switch Manipulation:
Modify game variables and switches after displaying messages.
Local Switches:
Change local switches for specific events, even across different maps.
Configure Messages:​
Open the event on the map where you want to add a message.
In the "Comments" section, add <msg> tags and other related tags (<var>, <switch>, <lswitch>) to define the message's behavior and appearance.
​
Spoiler:
Usage Examples
Code:
<msg id=1 text="Hello, traveler!" time=120 distance=2 repeat="onApproach" fontSize=18 textColor="#FFFFFF">
Description:
Message: "Hello, traveler!"
Display Duration: 120 frames (2 seconds)
Activation Distance: 2 tiles
Repeat Mode: onApproach (displays every time the player enters the zone)
Font Size: 18
Text Color: White (#FFFFFF)
Code:
<msg id=2 rand="How are you?|Nice to see you!|Long time no see!" time=150 distance=3 repeat="never" fontSize=16 textColor="#00FF00">
<msg time=60>
<var id=5 value=10>
Description:
Random Messages: One of "How are you?", "Nice to see you!", or "Long time no see!"
Display Duration: 150 frames (2.5 seconds)
Activation Distance: 3 tiles
Repeat Mode: never (displays only once)
Delay: 60 frames (1 second) between messages
Variable Change: Sets variable with ID 5 to 10 after the message
Code:
<msg id=3 text="This is a secret message." time=180 distance=2 repeat="onMapReload" fontSize=20 textColor="#FF00FF">
<switch id=7 value=true>
<lswitch eventId=4 switchId=B value=false mapId=10>
Description:
Message: "This is a secret message."
Display Duration: 180 frames (3 seconds)
Activation Distance: 2 tiles
Repeat Mode: onMapReload (displays every time the player returns to the map)
Font Size: 20
Text Color: Magenta (#FF00FF)
Switch Change: Sets switch with ID 7 to true
Local Switch Change: Sets local switch B of event ID 4 on map ID 10 to false
